claim: Burgan Bank's Al Rateb salary account needs a salary of at least KD 400 for expatriates

quote: Residents need to show their Civil ID (or “Bataka”) to register a SIM card.

quote: A valid passport (not a photocopy)

quote: Telecom providers must ensure that every new customer identity is verified accurately

claim: Kuwait is the main destination for Bangladeshi nurses

quote: In October 2025, Kuwait sought to recruit 100 nurses from Bangladesh through Bangladesh Overseas Employment and Services Limited (BOESL).

quote: Candidates were required to demonstrate English proficiency, at least three years of work experience, relevant technical skills and certification in basic life support.

claim: Offered salaries: up to Tk 1.27 lakh for BSc nurses and Tk 1.11 lakh for diploma nurses
quote: The offered salaries reached Tk1.27 lakh for BSc nurses and Tk1.11 lakh for diploma nurses.

claim: Of 100 who sat the recruitment exam, 15 were selected

claim: By May 2026 only five had completed visa processing

claim: By end-2024, 677 Bangladeshi nurses had been placed in Kuwaiti public hospitals since structured deployment began in 2022 (BOESL Annual Report 2023-24)
quote: By the end of 2024, a total of 677 Bangladeshi nurses had been placed in Kuwaiti public hospitals, according to the BOESL Annual Report 2023–24.

claim: In May 2023 the Bangladesh Embassy in Kuwait signed an MoU with Kuwait's health ministry on recruiting medical professionals (G2G)
quote: the Bangladesh Embassy in Kuwait City signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the health ministry of Kuwait last month.

claim: City Group General Trading Company and Advanced Technology Company, with MOH approval, sought 998 nurses through BOESL in December 2021
quote: the City Group General Trading Company and the Advanced Technology Company of Kuwait submitted demand letters to the Embassy on December 2021 for recruitment of 998 nurses through Bangladesh Overseas Employment and Services Limited (BOESL)

claim: A selection committee of Kuwait MOH and the companies selected 654 nurses in Bangladesh in January 2022
quote: a selection committee comprising of the Ministry of Health, Kuwait and representatives from respective company visited Bangladesh to recruit nurses for both of the companies and finalized a total number of 654 nurses.

claim: The first 50 nurses arrived in June 2022 for MOH government hospitals, officially free of cost

claim: BOESL nurses (2022) went without migration cost; salary Tk 80,000-90,000 a month with overtime and yearly increment

claim: The 2022 BOESL nurses were recruited without migration cost through City Group General Trading and Advance Technology Company
quote: The professionals are being recruited without migration cost through City Group General Trading Company and Advance Technology Company in Kuwait.

claim: Dataflow primary source verification of credentials is mandatory for the Kuwait MOH licence
quote: Submit credentials through Dataflow for the Kuwait MOH pathway - mandatory and cannot be waived.

claim: The employer submits the licence application with the Dataflow report on MOH's portal; fees are paid online
quote: Your employer submits the formal licence application with your Dataflow report and all supporting documents. Fees are paid online.

claim: MOH then sends exam eligibility; the candidate sits a computer-based Prometric exam, results go to MOH
quote: Register with Prometric, select a test centre (international centres available for most professions), and sit the written exam.

claim: Nurses need 3 years' experience, now in an acute inpatient setting
quote: Nurses remain at 3 years but experience must now be in an acute inpatient setting

claim: Documents include a good standing certificate within 6 months, the Dataflow receipt, a criminal background check and vaccination records
quote: a good standing certificate (within 6 months), Dataflow receipt, criminal background check, vaccination records, and passport copies

quote: If you hold a Kuwait residency or work permit, that status is checked separately

quote: which now handles tourist, family, business, and government visit visas

quote: Download the app from Apple App Store, Google Play or Huawei AppGallery.

quote: Tap on ‘Get started’ and then on ‘registration’.

claim: Civil ID status page: click 'Card Status', enter the Civil ID number, submit
quote: Click on ‘Card Status’.

claim: Labour Law 6/2010 excludes domestic workers, whose affairs are organised separately
quote: Domestic Workers regarding whom a decision shall be issued by the competent Minister for organizing their affairs

claim: Labour Law 6/2010 applies to private-sector employees
quote: The provisions of this law shall be enforceable to the private sector employees.

claim: The law's provisions are the minimum for workers' rights; better contract terms prevail
quote: the provisions of this law shall represent the minimum limit for the labourers' rights

claim: The contract must be written and state the signing date, start date, wage, period (if limited) and nature of work, in three copies, one for each party and one for the Ministry
quote: An work contract shall be prepared in writing and shall particularly consist of the date of signing the contract, the effective date, amount ofwage, contract period if itis for a limited period and the nature of work. The contract shall be drawn up into three copies; one for each party whereas the third copy shall be sent to the Competent Authority at the Ministry.

claim: The wage may not be reduced during the contract; any agreement to reduce it is void
quote: the labourer wage Shall not be reduced during the validity of the contract. Any agreement signed before the validity of the contract or subsequent thereto shall be deemed absolutely void

claim: The employer may not assign work not in line with the work stated in the contract
quote: an employer may not assign the labourer to perform a work which is not in line with the nature of the work stated in the contract

claim: Contracts are in Arabic; a translation may be attached but Arabic prevails
quote: All contracts shall be made in Arabic language and the translation of which in any foreign language can be added to it, but the Arabic language shall have preference in case of discrepancies.

claim: A fixed-term contract lasts from one to five years and can be extended by agreement
quote: If the employment contract is for a limited period, its term shall not be more than five (5) years and not less than one year.

claim: Probation is at most 100 working days; either side may end the contract during it without notice
quote: it shall not exceed hundred working days. Either party may terminate the contract during the probation period without notice.

claim: If the employer ends the contract during probation it must pay end-of-service indemnity for the period worked
quote: If the termination is made by the employer, he shall pay the labourer his terminal service indemnity for his employment period

claim: An employer on a government project or employing workers in remote areas must provide suitable free housing and transport, or a housing allowance
quote: he shall provide a suitable accommodation and means of transport for his labourers free of charge. In the event of not providing them an accommodation, he shall give them a suitable housing allowance.

claim: Penalty deductions may not exceed five days' wage a month
quote: No deduction may be executed from the worker's wage for a period of more than five days monthly.

claim: Dismissal for misconduct under Article 41(b) does not take away the end-of-service indemnity
quote: In all these cases, the termination decision shall not result in depriving the labourer of his terminal service indemnity.

claim: A dismissed worker may appeal the dismissal to the Labour Circuit and, if dismissal is found arbitrary, gets indemnity plus compensation
quote: If it is evident by virtue of a final court judgment that the employer has terminated the labourer in an arbitrary way, the latter shall be entitled to a terminal service indemnity and compensation for the material and moral damages incurred by him.

claim: A worker absent without acceptable reason for 7 consecutive days or 20 non-consecutive days in a year may be deemed to have resigned
quote: If alabourer discontinues work without an acceptable reason for seven consecutive days or twenty interrupted days within one year, the employer may deem him resigned legally.

claim: A worker jailed on the employer's charge is suspended, not dismissed, until a final conviction; if acquitted he gets his wage for the period plus compensation
quote: If a judgment is issued on his innocence from the charge(s) attributed to him by the employer, the employer shall be obliged to pay him his wage for the period of suspension along with indemnifying him in a fair compensation to be decided by the court.

claim: For an open-ended contract, written notice is at least three months for a monthly-paid worker
quote: At least three months prior to the termination of the contract, in the event of monthly salary labourer.

claim: During the employer's notice, the worker may take one paid day or 8 hours a week to look for another job
quote: the labourer shall have the right to be absent from work for one full day within a week or eight (8) hours during the week in order to search for another job along with his entitlement to his wage

claim: The employer may not end the contract while the worker is on leave
quote: The employer may not use his right to terminate the contract under the previous Article while the labourer enjoys one of his leaves provided for in this law.

claim: A worker may not be dismissed for claiming his legal rights, or for sex, origin or religion
quote: as a result of claiming for or enjoyment of his legitimate rights according to the provisions of the law. Also, a labourer service shall not be terminated by reason of his sex, origin or religion.

claim: A side that wrongly ends a fixed-term contract compensates the other, up to the wage for the remaining contract period
quote: the compensation amount shall not exceed what is equal to the labourer's wage for the remaining period of the contract

claim: The worker may end the contract without notice and keep the indemnity if the employer breaks the contract or law, assaults him, or committed fraud at contracting
quote: A labourer shall have the right to terminate the work contract without notice together with his entitlement to the terminal service indemnity in any of the following cases:

claim: One such case is the employer not abiding by the contract and the law
quote: If the employer does not abide by the provisions of the contract and the law.

claim: The contract ends on the worker's death, proven incapacity, or illness that used up sick leave
quote: The employment contract shall expire by the death of the labourer or if it is evident that he is unable or disable to perform his duty or by reason of such a sickness that consumed his sick leave

claim: The contract ends if the employer is declared bankrupt by final judgment or the firm closes for good; if the firm is sold or merged, contracts continue with the new owner
quote: However, if the firm is sold or merged in another firm or if it is transferred by the means of inheritance, donation or any other legal action, the work contract shall be effective on the successors under the same conditions mentioned therein.

claim: For monthly-paid workers the end-of-service indemnity is 15 days' wage per year for the first five years and one month per year after, capped at one and a half years' wage
quote: A fifteen-day-wage for every one year of service of the first five years, and one month salary for very year of the following years, provided that the total indemnity shall not exceed one and a half year wage, with regard to monthly paid labourers.

claim: For daily, weekly, hourly or piece-rate workers it is 10 days' wage per year for the first five years and 15 days per year after, capped at one year's wage
quote: A ten days wage, for every one year of service of the first five years and fifteen (15) days wage for every one year of service for the following years, provided that the total indemnity shall not exceed a year wage

claim: Part years count pro rata, and debts or loans owed to the employer are deducted from the indemnity
quote: A labourer shall be entitled to the terminal service indemnity for any part of the year in proportion to the period of service he spent in the work. The amount of any debts or loans which may be due from the labourer shall be deducted from the terminal service indemnity

claim: The full indemnity is due when the employer ends the contract, when a fixed-term contract expires without renewal, or under Articles 48-50
quote: If the contract is terminated by the employer.

claim: The full indemnity is due when a fixed-term contract expires without renewal
quote: Upon the expiry of the term of the limited contract period without being renewed.

claim: A worker who resigns from an open-ended contract gets half the indemnity after 3-5 years, two-thirds after 5-10 years and all of it after 10 years
quote: The labourer shall have the right to receive half the terminal service indemnity, as stipulated in Article (51), if he terminates the unlimited period contract from his own part, and the term of his service is not less than three (3) years and did not complete five (5) years.

claim: At the end of the contract the employer must give a service certificate (period, profession, last salary) and return the worker's documents
quote: The employer shall return to the labourer any documents or certificates which may be submitted by him.

claim: The service certificate states service period, profession and last salary
quote: a service termination certificate which consists of a statement of his period of service, profession and the last salary he obtained

claim: Allowances and other cash benefits paid regularly count as part of the wage
quote: the allowances, remunerations, commissions, grants, donations or cash privileges received by the labourer periodically shall be included within the calculation of the wage

claim: Monthly-paid workers must be paid at least once a month, and pay may not be more than seven days late
quote: The payment of salaries shall not be delayed after the seventh day of the due date.

claim: Monthly-paid workers are paid at least once a month
quote: Monthly rate workers shall be paid their salaries at least once a month.

claim: Employers must pay wages into the workers' accounts at local financial institutions and send the Ministry a copy of the statements
quote: shall deposit their salaries in their relevant accounts opened with local financial institutions

claim: No more than 10% of the wage may be deducted to repay a debt or loan to the employer, without interest
quote: No more than 10% of a worker's wage may be deducted for the settlement of any debts or loans which may be due for the employer; and the employer shall not receive any interest on such entitlements.

claim: Total wage retention or deduction for debts is limited to 25%
quote: save within the limits of 25% for settling a debt of alimony, food, clothes and other debts, including the employer's debts

claim: Workers can't be forced to buy food or goods from certain shops or from the employer
quote: The labourers shall not be obliged to buy any foodstuff or commodities from certain shops or to buy from the employer's products.

claim: If the firm is closed for reasons the workers have no hand in and the employer wants them to keep working, it must pay wages for the closure period
quote: he shall be obliged to pay the salaries of his labourers for the entire period during which the firm is closed, whether totally or partially, for any other reason which the workers have no hand in it

claim: Dues are calculated on the last salary paid
quote: When calculating the labourer dues, the last salary paid to him shall be considered.

claim: Maximum hours are 8 a day and 48 a week; in Ramadan 36 a week
quote: the labourer shall not be made to work for more than 8 hours a day or 48 hours a week, save the cases provided for herein. Working hours during the holy month of Ramadan shall be 36 hours a week.

claim: No more than five hours in a row without a break of at least one hour, not counted as working time
quote: The labourer shall not be made to work for more than five continuous hours per day without being followed a break period of not less than one hour. Break hours shall not be calculated within the working hours.

claim: Overtime needs a written order, is limited to 2 hours a day, 180 hours a year, 3 days a week and 90 days a year, and is paid at least 25% above the normal rate
quote: The additional working hours shall not be more than two hours per day and in a maximum number of one hundred eighty (180) hours per year. Also the additional work periods shall not exceed three days a week and ninety days per year.

claim: Overtime pay is at least 25% above the ordinary rate, the worker may prove overtime by any means, and the employer must keep an overtime record
quote: the labourer's right to obtain a wage against the overtime hours in a rate which is more than his ordinary rate in a similar period by 25%

claim: Overtime is worked under a written order from the employer
quote: a labourer may be made to work overtime hours under a written order issued by the employer

claim: The employer must keep a record of overtime hours and pay
quote: The employer shall keep a special record for the overtime work hours indicating the dates of relevant days, number of overtime hours and the respective wages

claim: One fully paid day off (24 hours) after every six working days; work on it is paid at least 50% extra plus another day off
quote: The labourer shall receive at least 50% of his salary in addition to the original salary. Also he shall be compensated another day for his off day.

claim: Weekly day off of 24 hours after six working days, fully paid
quote: The labourer shall have the right to one fully paid weekly off day which shall be fixed by _24 continuous hours after every six worked days.

claim: Work on an official holiday is paid double plus a day off in lieu
quote: he shall be paid a double wage together with an alternative compensation day

claim: Paid official holidays include three days each for Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha
quote: Eid Al Fitr (Lesser Bairam) -Three days

claim: Sick leave a year: 15 days full pay, 10 at three-quarters, 10 at half, 10 at a quarter, 30 unpaid
quote: -15 days - with full wage

claim: Sick leave needs a certificate from the doctor chosen by the employer or a government health centre doctor
quote: The sickness which needs a sick leave, shall be evidenced by a certificate from the physician to be determined by the employer or the doctor who is in charge of a government health center.

claim: Paid annual leave is 30 days; in the first year only after nine months
quote: The labourer shall have the right to a paid annual leave of thirty days. However, a labourer shall be entitled to a leave for the first year only after the completion of at least nine months in the service of his employer.

claim: Leave pay is paid in advance before the leave
quote: The labourer shall have the right to be paid his due salary for the annual leave in advance before obtaining his leave.

claim: The employer sets the leave date; leave can be accumulated up to two years
quote: The employer shall have the right to determine the annual leave date

claim: Leave can be accumulated, up to two years' leave
quote: The labourer shall have the right to accumulate his leaves on condition that they shall not exceed the leaves of two years.

claim: Accumulated untaken leave is paid in cash when the contract ends
quote: the labourer shall have the right to receive a cash equivalent against his accumulated annual leave days upon the expiry of the contract

claim: A worker who works for another employer during leave must repay the leave pay
quote: The employer shall have the right to reimburse from the labourer any salary paid by him against the leave if it is proven that he is working during his leave with another employer.

claim: After two years with the employer, a worker who has not done Hajj gets 21 days' paid Hajj leave
quote: The labourer who completes two continuous years in the service of his employer shall be entitled to a paid leave of 21 days for performing Haj rituals, provided that he should not have previously performed the Haj.

claim: Three days' paid leave on the death of a first- or second-degree relative
quote: The labourer shall have the right to a leave with full pay of three days upon the death of a first or second grade relative.

claim: Nothing may be charged or deducted for safety equipment
quote: The labourer shall not be afforded with any expenses or any amounts may be deducted from his salary against the provision of protection measures & safety tools for him.

claim: The employer must post the daily working hours, breaks, weekly off day and holidays at the workplace
quote: consisting in particular of the daily working hours and the break period therein, the weekly off day and official holidays

claim: The employer must insure its workers with insurance companies against work injuries and occupational diseases
quote: the employer shall be obliged to arrange the required insurance coverage over his workers with insurance companies against work injuries and occupational diseases

claim: The employer must report a work injury (including on the way to or from work) to the area police station, the Labour Department and the insurer; the worker or his representative may report it too
quote: This proclamation may be made by the worker if his health so permits and also, it may be notified by whoever represents him.

claim: Injuries on the way to and from work count, and the employer reports them to the area police station and Labour Department
quote: If the worker is injured due to reason and in the course of or on his way to and from the work, the employer shall report the accident immediately

claim: The employer pays treatment of a work injury or occupational disease, including medicine and transport
quote: the employer shall bear the expenses of the injured labourer treatment against work injuries and occupational diseases with a governmental hospital or a private clinic to be determined by him, including the value of the medicine and transport expenses

claim: Worker or employer may object to the doctor's report on disability within one month before the Ministry of Health's Medical Arbitration Committee
quote: may object to the medical report within one month from the date of being informed thereof before the Medical Arbitration Committee at the Ministry of Health

claim: An injured worker gets full wage during treatment, half after six months, until recovery, disability or death
quote: A labourer who suffers a work injury or occupational disease shall be entitled to receive his wage for the entire treatment period fixed by the medical doctor. If the treatment period exceeds six months, he shall be entitled only to half the wage

claim: The injured worker or his heirs get compensation according to a ministerial schedule
quote: The injured labourer or his beneficiaries shall be entitled to receive compensation for work injuries or occupation all diseases pursuant to the schedule to be issued by a resolution from the Minister

claim: Compensation is lost if the injury was self-inflicted or due to gross misconduct, including acting under drink or drugs, unless it causes death or over 25% permanent disability
quote: Any act committed by the injured under the effect of drinks or drugs and every violation to the instructions regarding the protection against the work hazards

claim: Occupational disease appearing within one year after leaving service is still covered
quote: during his service or within one year after leaving the service

claim: An employer that recruited workers it did not need bears the cost of returning them home; if a worker leaves and works for another employer, the original employer registers an absconding notice
quote: in this case, the employer shall bear the expenses for returning the labourer to his country

claim: An employer that fails to pay wages into bank accounts as required faces a fine up to the total unpaid dues, and must still pay them
quote: an employer shall be punished by a penalty not exceeding the total of labourers dues which he fails to pay

claim: Workers' claims are not heard after one year from the end of the contract
quote: after the lapse of one year from the employment contract expiry date shall not be heard

claim: Workers' lawsuits are free of court fees and handled urgently
quote: The actions filed by labourers or their beneficiaries shall be exempted from the judicial fees.

claim: Labour cases are handled on a prompt summary basis
quote: Labour cases shall be looked into forthwith on prompt summary basis.

claim: Workers' dues take priority over the employer's other money and property, except a private home
